title: Review the decision pattern, not just the seat
short_social_title: The pattern matters more than the seat
summary: Review repeated decision patterns across positions when the lesson is not tied to a specific seat.
canonical_lesson: A recurring decision pattern can be strategically useful across every table position. Treat the lesson as position-independent instead of inventing an unknown seat.
example_spot: The same decision pattern appears in several hands with Hero and Villain occupying different seats.
common_mistake: Restricting a general lesson to one observed position and missing equivalent decisions elsewhere.
better_play: Match the strategic pattern across positions when position is intentionally not a constraint.
when_to_use: The strategic lesson applies regardless of seat
when_not_to_use: Position materially changes the recommended range or action
one_thing_to_remember: Any position is a wildcard; unknown position is missing information.
